# `assets_library` — module reference

Rendered from the module's own manifest, and from nothing written by hand. What the module *does* is [its own page](../modules/assets-library/index.md).

| Licence tier | — |

## Activation

**This module cannot be switched off.** Media storage. Product images, CMS media and e-mail assets all resolve here, and "we do not want files" is not a business decision.

## Dependencies

| Module | Binding | What it means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `auth` | yes | installs and migrates after it, and an operator cannot switch it off underneath this module |
